name: ai-compiler-workbench
displayName: AI Compiler Workbench -- Agentic Graph Visualiser
description: Agentic pipeline that discovers HuggingFace models, checks nntrainer compatibility, and generates nntrainer-compatible C++ + an interactive knowledge graph, orchestrated with LangGraph/LangChain.

aiCompilerWorkbench.pythonPath.description: Python interpreter to use. The extension will offer to auto-install torch/transformers/langchain into it, but the interpreter itself must already exist.

aiCompilerWorkbench.anthropicApiKey.markdownDescription: Your own Anthropic API key. Used by the **Compatibility Agent** (op-fix suggestions), the **Auto-Fix Agent** (compiler-error patches), and the **Chat** panel. Leave blank to skip all three -- the deterministic agents (discovery, tracing, weight download/conversion, INI/C++/graph generation, compiling, profiling, artifacts) all work without it.

aiCompilerWorkbench.clineUmsToken.markdownDescription: Your Cline UMS token (from Cline SR extension settings) or Ollama API key (use 'ollama'). Used by the **Chat** panel and **LLM Code Generation** as an alternative to Anthropic API key.

aiCompilerWorkbench.clineApiBase.markdownDescription: Base URL for the LLM API endpoint. For Ollama, set to `http://localhost:11434/v1`. For Cline/Gauss, use `http://localhost:6543/v1`.

aiCompilerWorkbench.clineModel.markdownDescription: Model name for LLM generation. Defaults to Claude Sonnet (faster, reliable for code generation). For Ollama, explicitly set a local model tag such as `llama3.1:8b` or `codellama:7b`. Use 'opus' for more complex reasoning tasks.

aiCompilerWorkbench.claudeCliTimeout.markdownDescription: Timeout in seconds for Claude Code CLI calls. Increase for large prompts or complex code generation tasks. Default is 300 seconds (5 minutes).

aiCompilerWorkbench.nntrainerPath.markdownDescription: Path to a local nntrainer install **prefix** (a directory containing `include/nntrainer` and `lib/`), built from [nntrainer/nntrainer](https://github.com/nntrainer/nntrainer) via `meson --prefix=<this path> build && ninja -C build install`. Required only for **Profile On-Device**; everything else works without it. If left blank, the extension will use the workspace root as the nntrainer repo path.

aiCompilerWorkbench.nntrainerRepoPath.markdownDescription: Path to a local clone (via `git clone`, not a downloaded zip -- submodules require real git metadata) of the [nntrainer/nntrainer](https://github.com/nntrainer/nntrainer) source repo. Used by **Build nntrainer From Source**; defaults to workspace root if not set.

aiCompilerWorkbench.causallmProjectRoot.markdownDescription: Path to your CausalLM integration project (the one with `transformer.h`, `causal_lm.h`, `<arch>_causallm.h`), used only when **Install Generated Files** is enabled below. Generated CausalLM components (`generated_<arch>_causallm.{h,cpp}`) always get written to `<output>/generated/causallm/<arch>/` regardless of this setting -- this only controls whether they're *also* copied into your real project. Defaults to `<workspace>/Applications/CausalLM` if not set.

aiCompilerWorkbench.generatedHeaderDirec.description: Directory (relative to causallmProjectRoot) that generated .h files are copied into, when installGeneratedFiles is enabled.

aiCompilerWorkbench.generatedSourceDirec.description: Directory (relative to causallmProjectRoot) that generated .cpp files are copied into, when installGeneratedFiles is enabled.

aiCompilerWorkbench.installGeneratedFile.markdownDescription: When enabled, copies generated CausalLM `.h`/`.cpp` files into `causallmProjectRoot`'s generated-header/source directories after each run. **Off by default** -- this writes into a project outside the extension's own output directory, so it's opt-in rather than something a first run does silently.

aiCompilerWorkbench.useDockerBuild.markdownDescription: When enabled, builds nntrainer inside a Docker container instead of on the host system. Useful for creating consistent, reproducible builds across different platforms. Requires Docker to be installed and running. **Off by default** -- use the host system's toolchain unless you need Docker isolation.

aiCompilerWorkbench.causallmPath.markdownDescription: Path to the CausalLM repository (`Applications/CausalLM`). Required for generating `.bin` weight files. If left blank, the extension will search in common locations.

aiCompilerWorkbench.enableQuantization.description: Enable optional weight quantization after conversion to reduce model size.

aiCompilerWorkbench.defaultQuantizationP.description: Default quantization preset. 'none' = FP32 only, 'Q4_0-FP32' = Q4_0 FC layers + FP32 embedding, etc.

aiCompilerWorkbench.targetISA.description: Target instruction set architecture for quantized weights. x86_64 or ARM64.

aiCompilerWorkbench.nntrQuantizePath.markdownDescription: Path to `nntr_quantize` binary. If empty, will search PATH and common locations.
